WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ca_state AS ctr_state,
        SUM(cr_returned_amount) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM 
        catalog_returns cr
    JOIN 
        date_dim d ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN 
        customer_address ca ON cr.cr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE 
        d.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY 
        cr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state
),
customer_total_return_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ctr_state,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) AS avg_ctr_total_return
    FROM 
        customer_total_return
    GROUP BY 
        ctr_state
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_id AS c_customer_id,
    c.salutation AS c_salutation,
    c.first_name AS c_first_name,
    c.last_name AS c_last_name,
    ca.street_number AS ca_street_number,
    ca.street_name AS ca_street_name,
    ca.street_type AS ca_street_type,
    ca.suite_number AS ca_suite_number,
    ca.city AS ca_city,
    ca.county AS ca_county,
    ca.state AS ca_state,
    ca.zip AS ca_zip,
    ca.country AS ca_country,
    ca.gmt_offset AS ca_gmt_offset,
    ca.location_type AS ca_location_type,
    ctr.ctr_total_return
FROM 
    customer_address
JOIN 
    customer ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = customer.c_current_addr_sk
JOIN 
    customer_total_return ctr ON ctr.ctr_state = customer_total_return_avg.ctr_state AND ctr.ctr_total_return > (customer_total_return_avg.avg_ctr_total_return * 1.2)
WHERE 
    ca.state = 'TN'
ORDER BY 
    c.customer_id,
    c.salutation,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    ca.street_number,
    ca.street_name,
    ca.street_type,
    ca.suite_number,
    ca.city,
    ca.county,
    ca.state,
    ca.zip,
    ca.country,
    ca.gmt_offset,
    ca.location_type,
    ctr.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
